name: Skinless Roast Turkey Breast with Smooth Yukon Gold Mashed Potatoes
whyItWorks: The quintessential flare-safe holiday plate. Tender roasted white meat turkey breast is low in fat, ultra-high in protein, and completely gentle on the gut. Paired with peeled, smoothly whipped potatoes with a splash of broth or butter, it delivers guilt-free festive nourishment.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Carve white meat without the seasoned outer skin. Enjoy with skinless mashed potatoes lightly salted. Bypass celery-packed stuffing, fried onions, and whole-berry cranberry relish.
